title: Port Expose Guard
description: Stops a database or admin port being published to the internet by accident: it reads a docker run command, compose ports or a Kubernetes Service back as who can reach each port, flags databases bound to 0.0.0.0 (which Docker opens ahead of ufw), host networking, -P, NodePort or public LoadBalancer for internal services, a container port the image doesn't listen on and unquoted 22:22 that YAML reads as 1342, and fixes each in one tap (bind to 127.0.0.1, ClusterIP, the right port, quotes). It reads ${VAR} ports, long and { … } compose syntax and [::] binds, keeps CRLF line endings, and notes that 127.0.0.1 was LAN-reachable before Docker 28.
stops: Database port open to the internet
